independent.description: Original step selection and density mappings.

--ds-space-0.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 0px / 16 = 0rem.

--ds-space-0-25.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 2px / 16 = 0.125rem.

--ds-space-0-5.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 4px / 16 = 0.25rem.

--ds-space-1.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 8px / 16 = 0.5rem.

--ds-space-2.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 16px / 16 = 1rem.

--ds-space-3.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 24px / 16 = 1.5rem.

--ds-space-4.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 32px / 16 = 2rem.

--ds-space-5.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 40px / 16 = 2.5rem.

--ds-space-6.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 48px / 16 = 3rem.

--ds-space-8.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 64px / 16 = 4rem.

--ds-space-10.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 80px / 16 = 5rem.

--ds-space-12.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 96px / 16 = 6rem.

--ds-space-16.derivation: Independent selected 8-point scale with 2px/4px fractional steps; 128px / 16 = 8rem.

densityDerivation: Independent alias choices: compact uses the 4px half-step for inline gaps and smaller existing steps elsewhere. Preserve hit areas separately. Upper layout intervals widen after 48px.
